content.title: Data Center Demand a Long-Term Real Estate Driver: Bell
content.description: Elizabeth Bell, Co-Head of Real Estate at Hamilton Lane, says demand for data centers has surged more than 200% since 2010, driven largely by cloud computing and digital transformation.
